questions.title: Weighted Rademacher sums: sub-Gaussian parameter and right-tail bound
questions.description: Formal-only known-result evaluation of a concrete probability theorem used in empirical-process analysis. For any finite set of indices and arbitrary deterministic real weights, prove that the weighted canonical iid Rademacher sum is sub-Gaussian with parameter equal to the sum of squared weights, and prove the displayed right-tail bound for every nonnegative threshold. The precise imports, law, variables, weights, quantifiers, both conclusions, namespace and declaration name in formal_target_contract are frozen. The statement includes empty index sets and zero weights; do not strengthen its assumptions or replace its law. Use the existing indexed library, source inspection, proof-state search, file workspace and raw local Lean feedback as useful; no tool sequence is mandatory. Library reuse is allowed. Submit the exact target with a model-authored proof, or report an honest remaining gap. Retrieval, pseudo-formal review, diagnostic sketches and compilation of another declaration are not proof evidence. Success requires independent whole-target semantic review and an exact identity-bound, axiom-clean active-project kernel check. The reference proof and calibration controls are evaluator-only. This measures formalization/proving of a known result, not novel research, Theory development, Python/R or simulation.

formal_target_contract.lean_source_prefix:
import StatInference.ProbabilityMeasure.Rademacher

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open scoped BigOperators NNReal

namespace AIStatisticianBench

theorem rademacher_weighted_sum_subgaussian_tail
    (s : Finset ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF
      (fun omega => ∑ i ∈ s,
        a i * StatInference.ProbabilityMeasure.rademacherSequenceCoordinate i omega)
      (∑ i ∈ s, (⟨a i ^ 2, sq_nonneg (a i)⟩ : ℝ≥0))
      StatInference.ProbabilityMeasure.rademacherBoolSequenceLaw ∧
    ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t →
      StatInference.ProbabilityMeasure.rademacherBoolSequenceLaw.real
        {omega | t ≤ ∑ i ∈ s,
          a i * StatInference.ProbabilityMeasure.rademacherSequenceCoordinate i omega}
        ≤ Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / (2 * ∑ i ∈ s, a i ^ 2)) := by
